Author: platis
Name: XIV.fm
Punchline: Share what you are listening to in Final Fantasy XIV.
Description: XIV.fm displays Last.fm listening presence on cards anchored above player nameplates.
Changelog:
- Keep nearby players' cards visible instead of blinking off while location data refreshes.
- Remove your own card two minutes after syncing stops instead of showing the last track indefinitely.
- Recover automatically after being removed from a selected Relay or after it is deleted.
- Resume syncing after a connection is interrupted.
